locator.title: Наливной пол трескается и пылит? В чем может быть ошибка
locator.lead: Разбираем ошибки при заливке наливного пола, которые часто приводят к проблемам

nearest_text_before.text: В обоих случаях прочность поверхности пола пострадает.

nearest_text_after.text: Решение: строго соблюдать пропорции по инструкции производителя.

image_reading: An extreme low-angle view holds on a rough gray floor with powdery residue, pits, flakes, and fractured patches in sharp foreground focus.
The unfinished room and two standing figures are heavily blurred in the distance; the loose surface dust and tiny fragments are the only elements suited to subtle motion.
The shallow depth of field and low-resolution background limit animation to restrained movement across the foreground surface.
analysis.article_context: The body image illustrates the section on incorrect water dosage: too much water can produce segregation and a weak, dusty top layer, while either too much or too little water reduces surface strength. Its editorial focus is the visibly friable, damaged condition of the floor before the following recommendation to follow the manufacturer’s proportions exactly.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation emphasizes that incorrect water dosage can leave a self-leveling floor with a weak, dusty and damaged surface.
structured_intent.primary_action: Loose surface dust drifts across the friable floor and settles around its existing flakes and pits.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The dust has settled, leaving the damaged powdery texture and fractured patches clearly exposed.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The floor remains visibly weak, cracked and powdery through the final frame.

models.scene_plan: Five-second fixed low-angle shot. Fine surface dust begins moving immediately in a gentle left-to-right drift, develops into a restrained veil that curls around the existing flakes and pits, then settles near the end. The final frames clearly retain the exposed cracks, powder and friable texture; the distant figures remain blurred and stationary.
models.positive_prompt: Fine loose dust drifts slowly across the foreground floor from left to right, briefly lifting around the flakes before settling into the pits; keep the camera fixed and end with the cracked, powdery surface fully exposed and still visibly weak.

models.scene_plan: Five-second fixed shot focused on the damaged foreground. A broad but subtle layer of loose dust glides steadily across the surface for most of the duration, forming small eddies around raised fragments before gradually settling. The endpoint is a clearly readable powdery, cracked top layer with no suggestion that the floor has repaired or strengthened.
models.positive_prompt: A thin veil of loose floor dust steadily slides across the foreground, eddies around the broken patches, then settles and leaves the cracked powdery surface clearly exposed. Fixed camera.

models.scene_plan: Four-second focused moment with a fixed camera. A compact wave of fine dust starts at once, skims across the nearest rough patches at a slightly quicker natural pace, curls around the visible flakes, and subsides near the final frame. The damaged, dusty surface remains prominent and unchanged in meaning.
models.positive_prompt: With the camera fixed, fine dust skims quickly but gently across the foreground floor, curls around the flakes, and settles by the end, leaving the weak cracked surface visibly powdery and exposed.
